summary: PostgreSQL 18 image pin: one tested PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB pair, pinned by digest, with a static gate; born monitored (exporter overlay, required metrics, alerts with tests, scrape test).

contributes.role: the tested image pair (tags, per-platform digests, observed versions, verification date)
offline gate (make gates): no latest, index digest on every reference, PG 18, pair rule, tag/version/data_directory consistency, staleness; checks compose files against the lock
PyYAML parse of one compose file for the gate (services, build/extends refusal, duplicate keys)
hermetic selftest and mutation proof of the gate (make selftests)
Docker test (make db-test, CI job db): starts the compose stack in a throwaway project and runs the SQL assertions; --variant plain|timescale
opt-in, needs Docker: starts each pinned image and compares its runtime facts with the lock; run when bumping the pair
hermetic selftest of the live verifier with a fake docker (make selftests)
additive overlay: the postgres_exporter service (digest-pinned, read-only, non-root, no cap, no host port, monitor password as a file)
the pinned exporter and promtool images (same line format as db/image.lock)
the exporter's non-secret connection settings (verify-full TLS, password file)
the monitoring contract: metric names a scrape must contain, one reason per line
Prometheus alert rules, each with severity, summary, description and runbook
promtool unit tests: a firing and a non-firing case for every alert
one section per alert: what it means and the first three checks
offline gate: alerts, contract, tests, runbook anchors and the exporter overlay agree (PyYAML)
Docker test (add to make db-test): starts db + exporter in a throwaway project, scrapes, asserts pg_up and every required metric; --mutate revoke-monitor must go RED
hermetic selftest and mutation proof of the parity check, the overlay rules and the scrape test with a fake docker (make selftests)
